claim: Replace with your project's one-sentence claim, e.g. 'My pipeline returns stellar parallaxes within 1% of SIMBAD for any named bright star.'
_notes: Copy this file to ground_truth_<lastname>.json and replace the example items with 8-10 of your own.
Every reference value must come from the cited source, never from an LLM. Re-check the examples below against SIMBAD before relying on them.
kind: 'numeric' (compared in physical units via pint) or 'exact' (string match, case-insensitive).
tolerance: one of {'abs': <value in the item's unit>}, {'rel': <fraction>}, {'sigma': <multiple of the reference uncertainty>}.
regime: 'typical' or 'edge'. Include at least 2 edge items where you expect the pipeline to struggle.
tool / arguments / field are optional; they are only used by --mode tool to score your MCP tool without the LLM in the loop.
